settings.permissions.title: Permissions
settings.permissions.description: Configure allow · ask · deny rules by tool / action / path to fine-tune tool confirmation.
settings.permissions.overview.title: How rules work
settings.permissions.overview.precedence: Precedence: deny > ask > allow (any matching deny rejects, then ask, then allow). User rules and legacy project rules are evaluated together with the same precedence; when no rule matches, behavior is identical to having no rules.
settings.permissions.overview.effects: allow: skip confirmation (including high-impact operations such as delete / execute code). ask: always prompt; Trust Low/Med will not auto-approve. deny: refuse to run and return an ordinary tool failure to the model.
settings.permissions.overview.yolo: YOLO (All) sessions ignore all rules, including deny. batch_execute matches each sub-operation individually.
settings.permissions.overview.syntax: Tool: exact name or * wildcard; shorthand such as manage_asset.delete / manage_script.* is allowed. Path: project-relative with forward slashes, ** supported (e.g. Assets/Plugins/**). For deny/ask any matching path takes effect; allow requires all paths to match.
